notes.title: Patch Notes v0.1.5 - New Map (Stealth Experiment)
notes.notes:
Launch Squad now has a new map called Hide.

The map is very dark, which brings in the stealth experiment. On Hide, when you stand still, your colors fade to black, making you nearly invisible.

Hide is an experiment on stealthy Launch Squad combat. I'm curious to see how the hiding comes into play. Whether or not it makes a huge difference, the map is still cool. 

Tip: Splatting near a hidden person will reveal them.

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.1.1
notes.notes:
We've posted a couple small updates in the past 24 hours or so. Mostly just small bug fixes and cosmetic changes. In order of largest to smallest changes:


    Searching for a game now gives you the choice of which server to join or to host your own. Turns out our old code was also limiting our game to one server at a time... isn't that nice.
    Tightened up the colors to make it less confusing who's on what team.
    Improved spawning
    More reliable face splat placement.
    Centered the nameplates
    Longer camera desaturation on death
    Small bugs that I forget...


Bigger changes coming soon!
